successes: Kimi K3.1 Pro weights were pinned to the window by X posts from 15:33Z, hourly counts and the previous run finding no public repo, even though the HF commit dates from 11-02 and the official post came 35 s after the window.
Model card, LICENSE and the full tech blog were read, so architecture, licence and cyber-mitigation facts come from primary sources.
failures: The model was not run (1.56 TB MXFP4 weights); all benchmarks remain Moonshot-reported.
Several X news-story candidates (RoboColosseum, Liber-0, BioSimBench, Curiosity, Locus) were not traced to primary sources.
The arXiv API only returned submissions from 16:00-19:00Z on 11-03 (one listing batch).
lessonsLearned: An HF repo committed days earlier can be made public in the window; the commit date is not the release date, so use first public reports and the prior run scan.
Official announcement posts can land seconds after the window end; record the weights availability time separately.
nextActions: Next run should treat the 16:00:35Z official Kimi post and post-window coverage as a duplicate of this article.
Watch Tencent Hy4 open weights and the reported GPT-6 Astra/Sol updates.
After merge and DigitalOcean deploy, run a real smoke test in a follow-up PR before promoting the mission.
